quote: If filepath.Rel fails, the file is silently skipped and Files returns success with an incomplete listing.
CI strips review_lens_count from every committed actuals record before validation, so the validator no longer checks that field for any fixture, not just the one known-bad record.
A file swapped to a FIFO between Lstat and Open could block os.Open indefinitely. (states the wait on a pipe, not the missing regular-file requirement)
writeReviewJSON ignores the error from p.stdout.Write and exits 0.

A package agents read failure other than a missing directory, such as a permission error, is now silently swallowed whenever the home agents directory lists cleanly. The error is returned only when both the package listing and the home listing fail.

Append writes the line with a single f.Write and does not check for a short write. The file is opened with O_NONBLOCK, so a FIFO or special file at the sidecar path (not a symlink) would be opened without blocking.
